controls.regle: An explicit map covers the ten risk categories of the current OWASP Top 10, each associated with at least one verified mitigation measure and its proof.
controls.verification: Request the risk → mitigation → proof map; verify that no Top 10 category is left without an associated measure or proof.
controls.preuve_attendue: OWASP Top 10 coverage table (category, measure, proof, verification date).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = 10 categories covered with proof ; partial = incomplete coverage or missing proofs ; non-compliant = no map
actions_audit: Request the OWASP Top 10 coverage map; verify its completeness against the current edition.
Sample 2-3 categories and verify the associated proof (test, configuration, code).
If gap: complete the map and schedule verification of the uncovered categories.
standards: OWASP ASVS 5.0 — V1 (Architecture, conception, threat modeling)

controls.regle: Every external input (user input, API parameter, imported file) is validated and sanitized server-side according to an expected format model; client-side validation is never the sole barrier.
controls.verification: Identify the exposed entry points (forms, API endpoints, file imports); verify the presence of systematic server-side validation (type, format, length, range) and the absence of any possible bypass from the client.
controls.preuve_attendue: Code or validation configuration excerpts per entry point + result of a malformed input test rejected server-side.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = systematic server-side validation on all recorded entry points ; partial = partial or inconsistent validation ; non-compliant = no validation or client-side only
actions_audit: Identify the exposed entry points and verify the server-side validation associated with each.
Submit a malformed/malicious input to a representative entry point; verify its rejection and logging.
If gap: instrument the missing validation and remove any reliance on client-side validation alone.

controls.regle: The project's direct and transitive dependencies are automatically scanned (SCA) at each significant change; any known, fixable critical or high vulnerability is subject to a dated remediation plan.
controls.verification: Run or review the latest SCA scan for the technology profile; verify the absence of any critical/high vulnerability without a remediation plan and the scan's execution frequency.
controls.preuve_attendue: Dated SCA scan report (list of CVEs, severity) + remediation plan for open vulnerabilities.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = recent scan, no critical/high CVE without a dated plan ; partial = high CVE with a plan but deadline exceeded ; non-compliant = critical CVE with no remediation or no scan
actions_audit: Run the SCA scan on the direct and transitive dependencies; attach the report.
Cross-check each critical/high CVE against a dated remediation plan and its owner.
If gap: update or isolate the vulnerable dependency and schedule the fix.
standards: OWASP Top 10 2021 — A06:2021 Vulnerable and Outdated Components
SLSA — niveau de provenance des builds

controls.regle: Each exposed entry point applies a rate-limiting policy (quotas, throttling) proportionate to the expected usage, protecting against abuse and application-level denial of service.
controls.verification: Identify the exposed entry points and their rate-limiting policy; test exceeding the quota and verify the controlled rejection response (code, message, logging).
controls.preuve_attendue: Rate-limiting policy configuration per entry point + result of a quota-exceeding test.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = rate limiting active and tested on all exposed entry points ; partial = partial or untested rate limiting ; non-compliant = no rate limiting
actions_audit: Identify the exposed entry points and their declared rate-limiting policy.
Trigger a quota-exceeding condition in a test environment; verify the controlled rejection.
If gap: instrument the missing rate limiting and define the thresholds per entry point.
standards: OWASP ASVS 5.0 — V13 (API et services Web)

controls.regle: Application sessions are protected against theft and replay (secure cookies, bounded expiration, identifier regeneration upon authentication), and any state-changing action is protected against cross-site request forgery (CSRF).
controls.verification: Inspect the session cookie attributes (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite), the session lifetime, and the presence of an anti-CSRF token on state-changing actions; test a forged request without a valid token.
controls.preuve_attendue: Session cookie configuration excerpts + result of the CSRF request test without a token (rejected).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = hardened cookies + systematic, verified CSRF token ; partial = partial hardening or token not verified everywhere ; non-compliant = unprotected session or no CSRF protection
actions_audit: Inspect the security attributes of the session cookies and the expiration policy.
Submit a state-changing request without a valid CSRF token; verify its rejection.
If gap: harden the cookies and extend CSRF protection to the relevant actions.
standards: OWASP Top 10 2021 — A01:2021 Broken Access Control

controls.regle: HTTP responses carry security headers aligned with the state of the art (content security policy, strict transport, anti-sniffing protection, referrer policy) across all exposed routes.
controls.verification: Analyze the HTTP response headers on a representative sample of exposed routes; verify their presence and their non-permissive configuration.
controls.preuve_attendue: Analysis capture of the security headers on the exposed routes (technology profile tool).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = recommended headers present and non-permissive on all routes ; partial = partial or permissive headers ; non-compliant = no security headers
actions_audit: Analyze the HTTP security headers on a sample of exposed routes; attach the capture.
Verify the precise configuration of each header (non-permissive values).
If gap: configure the missing headers or strengthen the permissive values.

controls.regle: No sensitive data (secret, personal data, authentication token) appears in clear text in the application logs; a redaction/masking mechanism applies before writing, regardless of the log level.
controls.verification: Trigger a logged event including sensitive data in a test environment; inspect the resulting log to verify its actual masking.
controls.preuve_attendue: Log excerpt showing masked sensitive data + configuration of the redaction mechanism.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = systematic redaction verified by test ; partial = partial redaction (some fields/levels not covered) ; non-compliant = sensitive data in clear text in the logs
actions_audit: Trigger, in a test, a logged event carrying a known sensitive data item; inspect the resulting log.
Verify the configuration of the redaction mechanism across all log levels and destinations.
If gap: instrument the missing redaction and purge the affected historical logs.
standards: OWASP Top 10 2021 — A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures

controls.regle: A static scan (SAST) and a dynamic scan (DAST) run on every significant change in continuous integration, with a blocking pipeline failure on any critical vulnerability.
controls.verification: Verify the SAST/DAST integration in the CI pipeline configuration and the recent execution history; confirm the blocking behavior on a critical vulnerability introduced in test.
controls.preuve_attendue: CI pipeline configuration (SAST/DAST steps) + recent execution report + proof of blocking on a critical vulnerability.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = SAST and DAST active and blocking in CI ; partial = only one of the two scans active or non-blocking ; non-compliant = no security scan in CI
actions_audit: Verify the presence and execution frequency of the SAST/DAST steps in the CI pipeline; attach the configuration.
Introduce a canary vulnerability and verify the pipeline blocks; attach the proof.
If gap: integrate the missing scans and configure the blocking threshold.

controls.regle: A formalized threat model covers the application's critical flows, assets, and trust boundaries, and is reviewed at every significant architectural change.
controls.verification: Request the threat model and its last review date; verify its correspondence with the actually deployed architecture.
controls.preuve_attendue: Dated threat model document + minutes of the last review and its trigger (architectural change).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = threat model up to date and covering the actual architecture ; partial = threat model exists but outdated ; non-compliant = no threat model
actions_audit: Request the threat model and verify its last review date.
Compare the threat model against the actually deployed architecture; note any coverage gaps.
If gap: produce or update the threat model and schedule its periodic review.

controls.regle: The production configuration eliminates default settings, demo accounts, debug mode, and any service or feature that is not strictly necessary, in order to minimize the attack surface.
controls.verification: Compare the production configuration against a hardening baseline; verify the absence of default accounts, active debug mode, and superfluous services.
controls.preuve_attendue: Capture of the production configuration compared against the hardening baseline + list of deviations.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = configuration aligned with the hardening baseline, no deviation ; partial = minor documented deviations ; non-compliant = active debug mode or default accounts present in production
actions_audit: Compare the production configuration against the technology profile's hardening baseline; note the deviations.
Specifically verify the absence of active debug mode and default accounts.
If gap: apply the hardening baseline and remove the superfluous elements.

controls.regle: Network egress is denied by default with an explicit list of allowed destinations; name resolution is governed and logged.
controls.verification: Inspect the network egress rules (default deny, allow list) and the name resolution configuration; verify the logging of resolutions and denied egress attempts.
controls.preuve_attendue: Export of the egress rules + name resolution configuration + log excerpt.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = default deny + allow list + logging all active ; partial = allow list without logging ; non-compliant = unrestricted network egress
actions_audit: Extract the effective network egress rules; attach the export.
Test an egress attempt to an unauthorized destination: it must be denied and logged.
If gap: establish the profile's default deny and allow list.

controls.regle: Vulnerabilities in the runtime base and dependencies are continuously inventoried; critical patches are applied within a defined, measured, and tracked timeframe.
controls.verification: Verify the continuous inventory of vulnerabilities (base + dependencies), the timeframe policy by severity, and the metrics for timeframe compliance.
controls.preuve_attendue: Dated inventory report + timeframe policy + remediation metric (e.g., average critical timeframe).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = continuous inventory + timeframes met and measured ; partial = inventory without timeframe tracking ; non-compliant = no inventory of the production estate
actions_audit: Extract the current vulnerability inventory and its freshness; attach.
Verify the timeframe policy by severity and its compliance over the last 3 months.
If gap: tool the continuous inventory and establish the patching policy.

controls.regle: A governed security program exists: named responsibilities, periodic team awareness training, security metrics tracked in review.
controls.verification: Verify the designation of security responsibilities, the awareness plan and its last execution, and the existence of periodically reviewed metrics.
controls.preuve_attendue: Organization chart/designations + awareness training trace + metrics review excerpt.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = responsibilities + awareness training + metrics all active ; partial = responsibilities without metrics ; non-compliant = no security governance
actions_audit: Identify the named security officers; attach the designation.
Collect the awareness plan/trace and the tracked metrics.
If gap: appoint responsible parties, schedule awareness training, define 3 starting metrics.
standards: OWASP SAMM — Governance (Strategy & Metrics, Education & Guidance)
